## Architecture fun fact (buildings)

The Pantheon in Rome has the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome (~142 ft diameter), built around 126 AD. Roman engineers used progressively lighter aggregate toward the top (heavy basalt at the base, pumice near the crown) so the dome could span the space without steel reinforcement — a trick modern engineers still admire.
